node380_subjob_statement.quote: Subjobs are either /sam(Hasso 10%JA Haste) or /war(DBL-Atk & abit slower TP-gain)
node380_subjob_statement.position: Immediately after the Melee Summoner! item sets 401864/401863/401865, before the Weaponskills! section
node380_subjob_statement.meaning: The guide author presents one set of three melee grids for either subjob. This attributes the twelve armor/accessory cells per grid to both /SAM and /WAR; the 10% figure and TP-gain comparison stay author statements.

reconciliation.detail: Hasso is SAM level 25 and Sub-Job Accessible (BG Samurai696531; official2006/2007). SMN99/SAM49 requires an actually unlocked, leveled SAM support job; the composition context requires Hasso to have been used and still be active (5:00 duration, 1:00 recast per BG752340). Availability is not uptime; no reapplication automation or live detection is implied.

reconciliation.topic: Two-handed staff, Seigan, expiration/cancellation and weapon changes
reconciliation.detail: Hasso works only with two-handed weapons (BG752340; FFXIclopedia1542307 adds hand-to-hand does not count; official2006). Exact Mpaca22100 is reviewed two_handed with grip Khonsu22218. Seigan and Hasso overwrite each other, so Seigan is inactive. Expiration, Seigan, dispel/cancellation or any non-two-handed main ends the credited state; no weapon swap is part of the composition.

reconciliation.topic: Master Hasso versus equipment and magic haste
reconciliation.status: resolved as category separation, no totals
reconciliation.detail: Hasso is job-ability haste (BG Hasso752340 and Attack_Speed757807; FFXIclopedia agrees). Equipment, magic and job-ability haste have separate category caps per Attack_Speed757807, so Hasso does not displace printed equipment haste. The 10% value is a source statement only; the page itself says equipment X/1024 values often run below descriptions. No aggregate delay, cap reached, x-hit or minimum haste is claimed. No magic haste, March, Hastega II or Haste Samba is credited.

At support level49 SAM lists Resist Blind III, Store TP II, Zanshin II, Demon Killer I and Damage Limit+ I (BG Samurai696531); level-50 rows need master-level support access and are not assumed. No /WAR Double Attack trait, Berserk, Aggressor or Warcry migrates. The Hasso-Zanshin extra-attack interaction is SAM-main-only (BG752340; FFXIclopedia) and is not credited. Hasso Effect job points and SAM merits are main-job categories and are not imported. Sub-level STR +7 is a source statement; no stat total is modeled.

reconciliation.topic: Spell casting/recast costs versus Blood Pact timing
reconciliation.status: resolved as stated caution, no timing claim
reconciliation.detail: While Hasso is active, magic, songs and Ninjutsu take a source-stated 50% casting and recast increase (BG752340; FFXIclopedia1542307; official2006 recast penalty). Summoning an avatar or other spells under Hasso are therefore slower. Blood Pact activation is a job ability (BG Category:Blood_Pact745754); no source read states a Hasso effect on Blood Pact delay in either direction, so no pact timing, delay total or schedule is claimed. The niche master-melee composition does not depend on a pact timing assumption.

reconciliation.topic: Living avatar versus Ward/Favor application and recipient
reconciliation.detail: Hasso is a self effect on the master; it does not transfer to the avatar. An ordinary avatar alive keeps Sroda Pet Alive conditional master Double Attack comparable with /WAR; it does not prove any Ward was used or applied to the master. No Favor, Crimson Howl, Crystal Blessing, Ward or avatar-supplied haste is credited.

reconciliation.topic: Whether /WAR fills and substitutions support /SAM counterparts
reconciliation.status: supported for identical gear, separately attributed
reconciliation.detail: The twelve armor/accessory cells per grid are attributed to either subjob by node380. The Nexus Mpaca/Khonsu/Seraphicaller fills, intentional empty range, DT neck/body/ring substitutions and Accuracy Taliah/Telos/Cessance/Chirich substitutions cite no /WAR trait or ability; their stated rationales are master-defense and master-accuracy tradeoffs. Hasso's two-handed condition is met by the reviewed staff. Equipment haste is not displaced (HASSO-03). The /SAM counterparts therefore retain identical 16 slot states under new immutable identities with an explicit Hasso-active context. No gear is claimed better or optimal for /SAM; no /SAM-specific rebalance is invented.
